title: Arkret Moderation Evidence Objects
description: Defs-only canonical objects shared by signed moderation reports, MIMI report mapping and durable franking-proof Events. This schema depends only on primitive/common schemas and does not reference an Event or operation request schema.

evidence_package.description: Canonical encrypted moderation evidence-package descriptor. target_refs names exactly the report target at admission; recipient_public_key_ref and encrypted_to MUST be byte-identical and resolve to an authorized moderator key for the report's exact effective scope. reporter_signature covers the descriptor and referenced ciphertext. The encrypted material MUST contain only reporter-visible evidence for target_refs and MUST NOT contain MLS epoch/exporter private material or unrelated plaintext.

franking_proof.description: Canonical receiving-service receipt used both inside a moderation report and as the complete payload of an ak.moderation.franking_proof durable Event. The local signature uses domain ak.franking_proof.signature.v1 and covers every member except signature. event_id names the encrypted Event whose receipt is proven; the enclosing proof Event has its own distinct Event.event_id.

event_id.description: Event ID of the encrypted Event whose receipt is proven; not the enclosing franking-proof Event ID.

verification_method.description: Exact receiving-service verification method used for signature. Its controller MUST project to received_by and the method MUST be authorized at received_at.

replay_nonce.description: Opaque anti-replay nonce generated by the receiving service and covered by the proof signature.

signature.description: Receiving service signature over the canonical franking-proof transcript.

ancestry_events.description: Complete canonical EventId-sorted ancestry needed to reach proof_event from the anchor frontier. Exact-ID dependency resolution supplies a missing remainder; incomplete evidence is pending, never verified.

franking_commit_observation_outcome.description: Optional security evidence that a franking-proof ordinary Event existed within a bounded interval. Independently verify the anchor RealmCommit quorum, the exact existence_anchor frontier, original Event producer proof and authority refs, service signer key validity over the full interval, and the exact target. The anchor interval must start no earlier than proof.received_at. This does not prove receiver-claimed delivery time exactly and is never required to send, accept or replicate ordinary messages. The Event does not enter RealmCommit.delta and no data observation root exists.
